name_note: GTDB s__Dialister invisus corresponds to the species named Dialister invisus in the literature; one genome labelled Prevotella merdae by NCBI is also placed here.

sentences.text: Dialister invisus is a bacterium detected in human faecal samples, where it has been identified among the predominant faecal microbiota.
A study of gut metagenomes and metatranscriptomes reported that Dialister invisus could be abundant in DNA yet inactive or dormant, with little or no gene expression.
In Crohn's disease, a decrease in Dialister invisus in faeces has been reported as part of a dysbiosis signature.

references.authors: Joossens M, Huys G, et al.
references.title: Dysbiosis of the faecal microbiota in patients with Crohn's disease and their unaffected relatives.
